paper_title: Detection of Potato Plant Leaf Diseases using CNN
core_problem: Slow or difficult access to disease identification in potato farming areas in Ethiopia, which is affected by foliar diseases like early blight and late blight.
methodology_summary: Development of a convolutional neural network (CNN) to recognize three potato leaf conditions: healthy leaves, early blight, and late blight. The model was compared against VGG16 and MobileNetV2.
datasets_eval: PlantVillage (2,215 images) and an independent field dataset from Banja Awi Zone, Ethiopia (247 images).
empirical_results: On PlantVillage: 99.04% training accuracy, 98.21% validation accuracy, 98.66% test accuracy. On the field dataset: 90.28% accuracy. The proposed model has 446,787 parameters, is 1.70 MB, and has a shorter training time than VGG16 and MobileNetV2. (Note: Mahapatra and Panda achieved 96.28% accuracy with a CNN on PlantVil).
explicit_limitations: The study notes that many existing potato-disease studies have limitations.
